Hello, Master ji? Main Sunita bol rahi h.text: Sunita Bansal says she is Sunita from Bansal, Model Town, and that last year you made her daughter-in-law's suit.
Hello, Master ji? Main Sunita bol rahi h.quote: Hello, Master ji? Main Sunita bol rahi hoon, Bansal, Model Town wali. Pichhle saal aapne meri bahu ka suit banaya tha.

Haan ji haan, Bansal ji, yaad hai. Namas.text: The worker says he remembers Bansal ji and greets her, then asks her to speak.
Haan ji haan, Bansal ji, yaad hai. Namas.quote: Haan ji haan, Bansal ji, yaad hai. Namaste. Boliye.

Master ji, beti ki shaadi hai, baarah De.text: Sunita says the job is for her daughter's wedding and includes a lehenga blouse and some suits.
Master ji, beti ki shaadi hai, baarah De.quote: Master ji, beti ki shaadi hai, baarah December ko. Uska kaam karwana hai aapse. Lehenga ka blouse aur kuch suits.

Master ji, beti ki shaadi hai, baarah De.text: Sunita says the wedding is on 12 December and the work is for that occasion.
Master ji, beti ki shaadi hai, baarah De.quote: Master ji, beti ki shaadi hai, baarah December ko. Uska kaam karwana hai aapse. Lehenga ka blouse aur kuch suits.

Mubarak ho ji, bahut mubarak. Kitne suit.text: The worker congratulates her and asks how many suits are needed.
Mubarak ho ji, bahut mubarak. Kitne suit.quote: Mubarak ho ji, bahut mubarak. Kitne suit?

Chaar suit. Aur lehenga ka blouse, aur l.text: The hirer says there will be four suits, a lehenga blouse, and lehenga fitting, and the hirer will provide all the cloth.
Chaar suit. Aur lehenga ka blouse, aur l.value: four suits, lehenga blouse, and lehenga fitting; material provided by hirer
Chaar suit. Aur lehenga ka blouse, aur l.quote: Chaar suit. Aur lehenga ka blouse, aur lehenga ki fitting bhi. Kapda sab mera hai, main de jaungi.

Theek. Dekhiye, blouse aur lehenga ki si.text: The worker says blouse and lehenga stitching will cost 4,500 rupees, and the four suits will cost 4,800 rupees total.
Theek. Dekhiye, blouse aur lehenga ki si.value: 4,500 rupees for blouse and lehenga stitching; 4,800 rupees for four suits
Theek. Dekhiye, blouse aur lehenga ki si.quote: Theek. Dekhiye, blouse aur lehenga ki silai saade chaar hazaar, aur suit baarah sau ek, chaar ke hue adtaalis sau.

Theek. Dekhiye, blouse aur lehenga ki si.text: The worker says the hirer should bring the lining, because he does not keep it.
Theek. Dekhiye, blouse aur lehenga ki si.value: lining to be brought by hirer
Theek. Dekhiye, blouse aur lehenga ki si.quote: Lining aap le aana, woh main nahi rakhta.

Arre baap re, nau hazaar teen sau? Maste.text: The hirer says the worker quoted 9,300 rupees.
Arre baap re, nau hazaar teen sau? Maste.quote: Arre baap re, nau hazaar teen sau? Master ji, itna to nahi. Pichhli baar to aapne...

Pichhli baar ek suit tha, Bansal ji. Ye.text: The worker says the previous job was one suit and that this job is bridal work with hand work in the blouse.
Pichhli baar ek suit tha, Bansal ji. Ye.value: one suit previously; bridal work with hand work in the blouse
Pichhli baar ek suit tha, Bansal ji. Ye.quote: Pichhli baar ek suit tha, Bansal ji. Ye bridal kaam hai, blouse mein haath ka kaam lagega.

Achha suniye, aath hazaar kar lijiye sab.text: The hirer proposes 8,000 rupees for all the work.
Achha suniye, aath hazaar kar lijiye sab.quote: Achha suniye, aath hazaar kar lijiye sab.

Achha suniye, aath hazaar kar lijiye sab.text: The hirer says she is an old customer.

Aath mein nahi hoga ji. Haan, nau hazaar.text: The worker says the price can be 9,000 rupees as a round figure.
Aath mein nahi hoga ji. Haan, nau hazaar.quote: Aath mein nahi hoga ji. Haan, nau hazaar kar deta hoon, round figure.

Nau hazaar... saara saaman milake na? La.text: The hirer asks whether the 9,000 rupees includes all materials together, including latkan and dori.
Nau hazaar... saara saaman milake na? La.quote: Nau hazaar... saara saaman milake na? Latkan, dori, sab?

Haan ji, saaman milake. Latkan to main a.text: The worker says the job includes all materials.
The worker says he puts on good latkans and brings them from Chandni Chowk.
Haan ji, saaman milake. Latkan to main a.quote: Latkan to main achhe wale lagata hoon, Chandni Chowk se laata hoon.

Theek hai, theek hai. Accha, trial kab h.text: The hirer asks when the trial will be.
Theek hai, theek hai. Accha, trial kab h.quote: Theek hai, theek hai. Accha, trial kab hoga?

Kapda kal parson de jaiye, to trial agle.text: The worker says to bring the cloth tomorrow or the day after, the trial will be next Sunday, and the full outfit will be ready by 5 December.
Kapda kal parson de jaiye, to trial agle.value: bring cloth tomorrow or the day after; trial next Sunday; ready by 5 December
Kapda kal parson de jaiye, to trial agle.quote: Kapda kal parson de jaiye, to trial agle Sunday ko, aur poora maal paanch December tak ready.

Paanch tak? Shaadi baarah ko hai... haan.text: The hirer accepts the worker's finish date of 5 December, saying it will be a week earlier so there is time for alterations.
Paanch tak? Shaadi baarah ko hai... haan.quote: Paanch tak? Shaadi baarah ko hai... haan, theek hai, ek hafta pehle mil jayega to alteration ka time rahega.

Bilkul. Koi dheela tight hua to wahin th.text: The worker says if anything is loose or tight, it will be fixed on the spot.
Bilkul. Koi dheela tight hua to wahin th.value: fix loose or tight items on the spot
Bilkul. Koi dheela tight hua to wahin th.quote: Bilkul. Koi dheela tight hua to wahin theek kar denge.

Paise ka batayiye, advance kitna?.text: The hirer asks how much advance there will be.

Jo aap theek samjhein. Aadha de dijiye..text: The worker says the hirer can pay half as advance.
Jo aap theek samjhein. Aadha de dijiye..quote: Jo aap theek samjhein. Aadha de dijiye.

Aadha to abhi nahi ho payega, shaadi ke.text: The hirer says she can pay 2,000 rupees now as the advance and the rest when she picks up the clothes.
Aadha to abhi nahi ho payega, shaadi ke.value: 2,000 rupees now, rest when collecting the clothes
Aadha to abhi nahi ho payega, shaadi ke.quote: Aadha to abhi nahi ho payega, shaadi ke kharche hain. Do hazaar abhi PhonePe kar deti hoon, baaki jab maal uthaungi tab.

Aadha to abhi nahi ho payega, shaadi ke.text: The hirer says the remaining balance will be paid when she picks up the clothes.
Aadha to abhi nahi ho payega, shaadi ke.quote: Aadha to abhi nahi ho payega, shaadi ke kharche hain. Do hazaar abhi PhonePe kar deti hoon, baaki jab maal uthaungi tab.

Aur Master ji, ek baat. Agar paanch tak.text: The hirer says that if it is not ready by the 5th, it would be a problem, and recalls that last Diwali the worker was three days late.
Aur Master ji, ek baat. Agar paanch tak.value: not ready by the 5th; three days late last Diwali
Aur Master ji, ek baat. Agar paanch tak.quote: Aur Master ji, ek baat. Agar paanch tak ready nahi hua to? Pichhli baar Diwali pe aapne teen din late kiya tha.

Arre woh to bijli chali gayi thi poore h.text: The worker says the delay last time was because the electricity was out for a whole week and says this time it will not happen, so she should not worry.
Arre woh to bijli chali gayi thi poore h.value: delay last time was due to no electricity for a week; this time it will not happen
Arre woh to bijli chali gayi thi poore h.quote: Arre woh to bijli chali gayi thi poore hafte. Is baar nahi hoga, aap tension mat lo. Pachchees saal se kaam kar raha hoon.

Arre woh to bijli chali gayi thi poore h.text: The worker says he has been working for twenty-five years.
Arre woh to bijli chali gayi thi poore h.quote: Arre woh to bijli chali gayi thi poore hafte. Is baar nahi hoga, aap tension mat lo. Pachchees saal se kaam kar raha hoon.

Haan wo to hai. Accha, beti ka naap aap.text: The hirer asks whether the worker will take the daughter's measurements or can manage using the old blouse.
Haan wo to hai. Accha, beti ka naap aap.quote: Haan wo to hai. Accha, beti ka naap aap loge ya purane blouse se kaam chal jayega?

Beti ko le aaiye ek baar, bridal mein pu.text: The worker says the bride's daughter must come once because bridal work cannot be done from old measurements and proper measurements are needed.
Beti ko le aaiye ek baar, bridal mein pu.quote: Beti ko le aaiye ek baar, bridal mein purane naap se nahi chalta. Naap sahi lena padta hai.

Gawah ji, aap sun rahe ho na? Maine adva.text: The hirer says she had said the advance was 2,000 rupees.
Gawah ji, aap sun rahe ho na? Maine adva.quote: Gawah ji, aap sun rahe ho na? Maine advance kitna bola, do hazaar hi na? Baad mein main bhool jaati hoon.

Haan haan, likh lijiye, sab saaf rahe..text: The worker says to write it down so everything stays clear.
Haan haan, likh lijiye, sab saaf rahe..quote: Haan haan, likh lijiye, sab saaf rahe.

Chalo. Accha Master ji, Pinky ke lehenge.text: The hirer says Pinky's lehenga will be a maroon color that the worker will like.
Chalo. Accha Master ji, Pinky ke lehenge.quote: Chalo. Accha Master ji, Pinky ke lehenge ka rang dekhoge to khush ho jaoge. Mehroon hai.

Achha ji. Mehroon pe golden latkan bahut.text: The worker says maroon will suit golden latkans well.
Achha ji. Mehroon pe golden latkan bahut.quote: Achha ji. Mehroon pe golden latkan bahut jachega.

Haan haan. Aur suno, uski saas bhi ek ta.text: The hirer says her daughter's-in-law's mother-in-law also knows a tailor in Lajpat Nagar, but she said no and that their master ji will do it.
Haan haan. Aur suno, uski saas bhi ek ta.value: knows a tailor in Lajpat Nagar; their master ji will do it
Haan haan. Aur suno, uski saas bhi ek ta.quote: Haan haan. Aur suno, uski saas bhi ek tailor jaanti hain Lajpat Nagar mein, par maine kaha nahi ji, hamare Master ji hi karenge.

Meherbani aapki. Bas kapda jaldi pahunch.text: The worker says the hirer should deliver the cloth quickly.
Meherbani aapki. Bas kapda jaldi pahunch.quote: Meherbani aapki. Bas kapda jaldi pahuncha dijiye.

Kal pakka. Kal shaam ko Pinky ke papa ch.text: The hirer says the cloth will be brought tomorrow, in the evening, by Pinky's father, and the work is confirmed for tomorrow.
Kal pakka. Kal shaam ko Pinky ke papa ch.quote: Kal pakka. Kal shaam ko Pinky ke papa chhod jayenge. Chalo phir, rakhti hoon.

Haan, aur lining bhi bhijwa dungi saath.text: Sunita says the lining will be sent along, or the worker can bring it.
Haan, aur lining bhi bhijwa dungi saath.quote: Haan, aur lining bhi bhijwa dungi saath mein... ya aap le aaoge? Chalo kal dekh lenge. Namaste.
